arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT json_object('config',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config),'bookings',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at)) FROM bookings),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',charge_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step)) FROM charges),'events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox),'cancellations',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events),'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights),'cache',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache),'fare_holds',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until_step',until_step)) FROM fare_holds)) AS snapshot

SELECT 'config' AS kind, json_object('service',service,'value',json(value)) AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'cancel_step',e.step) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON b.request_id=e.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'recent_error',json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 AND status!=409 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12)

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'cancel_step',e.step) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellation',json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'status',b.status,'event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step,'refund_total',(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_cents),0) FROM refunds r WHERE r.booking_id=b.booking_id),'has_hold',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',json(value)) FROM service_config
